clone.noAccount: No GitHub / GitLab account connected. Connect one to a profile to pick from its repositories.
clone.noRepos: This account has access to no repository.
clone.truncated: Only the {{count}} most recently active repositories are listed: refine the search or use the URL.
clone.name: Folder name

graph.author: Author
graph.synced: in sync with the remote branch
graph.columnsHint: Right-click the header to get back here.

details.label: Commit details
details.none: Select a commit to see its details.
details.merge: Merge commit: compared with the first parent.

diff.label: Diff of {{file}}
diff.empty: No content changes (mode or type change).
diff.truncated: Diff truncated: the file is too long to show in full.

sidebar.label: Branches and tags
sidebar.notFound: This commit is not in the history.

staging.label: Work in progress
staging.title: Work in progress
staging.clean: No changes: the working tree is clean.
staging.linesHint: Click changed lines to select them (Shift+click: range).
staging.resolvedHint: Stages the file once the conflict markers are removed
staging.discardFile: Unstaged changes to {{file}} will be lost. This cannot be undone.
staging.discardUntracked: The untracked file {{file}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
staging.discardFiles: Unstaged changes to these {{count}} files will be lost. This cannot be undone.
staging.discardLinesBody: These changes to {{file}} will be lost. This cannot be undone.
staging.discardAllBody_one: The file (staged or not) will go back to its last committed state; an untracked file will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
staging.discardAllBody_other: The {{count}} files (staged or not) will go back to their last committed state, and untracked files will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

commit.amendHint: Change the last commit (message and content) instead of creating a new one

gitMissing.title: Git was not found
gitMissing.body: GitGR relies on Git for every operation. Install it, or use the bundled version.
gitMissing.linuxHint: On Linux: install the “git” package with your package manager (e.g. sudo apt install git).

layout.diffSplit: Split between old and new version
layout.details: Height of the message and author

pull.ffOnlyHint: Does nothing if the branches have diverged (you are then asked what to do)
pull.mergeHint: Creates a merge commit when needed
pull.rebaseHint: Replays your local commits on top of the remote branch
pull.divergedBody: {{branch}} and its remote branch each have commits the other lacks. How should they be combined?
pull.divergedFromBody: {{branch}} and {{source}} each have commits the other doesn’t. How should they be brought together?

push.rejectedBody: The remote branch has commits you don’t have. Pull first, or overwrite it (force with lease: refused if someone pushed since your last fetch).

branch.name: Branch name
branch.deleteBody: The local branch is deleted; its commits remain reachable from the reflog.
branch.notMergedBody: Its commits are not in any other branch: once deleted, they will no longer show in the graph (the reflog keeps them for a while).
branch.deleteRemoteBody: The branch is deleted on the remote, for everyone. Your local branch is not touched.
branch.invalid: Invalid name (no spaces, no ~ ^ : ? * [ \ characters, no “..”).
branch.exists: A branch with this name already exists.

op.mergeHint: Resolve the conflicts, stage the files, then commit to finish the merge.
op.continueHint: Resolve the conflicts and stage the files, then continue.
op.abortBody: The repository goes back to its state before the operation; conflict resolutions in progress are lost.

notice.stashKept: Your changes could not be reapplied without conflicts: they are kept in the stash “{{label}}”. Resolve the conflicts, then drop the stash.
notice.popConflict: The stash was applied with conflicts; it is kept.
notice.conflicts: The operation stopped on conflicts: resolve them in the current changes.

autostash.pending: Changes put aside by GitGR (“{{message}}”) have not been reapplied.

hint.none: No profile: SSH uses its usual configuration

remotes.name: Remote name
remotes.invalidName: Invalid name (no spaces, no ~ ^ : ? * [ \ characters, no “..”).
remotes.exists: A remote with this name already exists.
remotes.removeBody: Its remote branches disappear from the sidebar, and local branches that tracked them no longer track anything. Nothing is deleted on the server.
remotes.accountNone: No {{provider}} account connected for this profile

errors.not_a_repo: This folder is not a Git repository.
errors.git_not_found: Git was not found on this machine.
errors.dubious_ownership: Git refuses this repository because it belongs to another user. Allow it with: git config --global --add safe.directory <path>
errors.diff_changed: The file changed in the meantime: the diff was reloaded, please select again.
errors.identity_missing: Git doesn’t know your identity (name and email). Pick a profile for this repository (bottom right) or set git config user.name / user.email.
errors.nothing_to_commit: Nothing to commit: stage some changes first.
errors.unsupported_encoding: This file is not UTF-8: its lines can’t be discarded one by one.
errors.no_commit_to_restore: This repository has no commit yet: there is no state to restore (everything would be deleted).
errors.branch_exists: A branch with this name already exists.
errors.branch_is_current: Cannot delete the current branch: switch to another branch first.
errors.local_changes_conflict: Your local changes would be overwritten. Commit them, stash them, or enable auto-stash in the settings.
errors.unresolved_conflicts: Some conflicts are not resolved: finish them first.
errors.operation_in_progress: An operation (merge, rebase…) is in progress: finish or abort it first.
errors.merge_needs_commit: To finish a merge, commit the resolved files.
errors.detached_head: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch first.
errors.no_upstream: This branch does not track a remote branch: push it first.
errors.not_fast_forward: The branches have diverged: a fast-forward is not possible.
errors.push_rejected: Push rejected: the remote branch has commits you don’t have.
errors.push_stale: Force push refused: the remote branch moved since your last fetch. Fetch and check before forcing.
errors.auth_failed: The server refused authentication (SSH key or credentials). Check the SSH key of this remote’s profile (right-click the remote in the sidebar) and, if it is protected, its passphrase.
errors.host_key_unknown: Unknown SSH host key: connect to the server once from the command line (ssh) to accept it.
errors.network_unreachable: Server unreachable: check the network connection and the remote address.
errors.remote_not_found: Remote repository not found (remote address or access rights).
errors.stash_would_overwrite: The stash would overwrite current changes: commit or stash them first.
errors.key_exists: A file with this name already exists: pick another one (an existing key is never overwritten).
errors.not_a_key: This file is not an SSH key.
errors.ssh_keygen_not_found: ssh-keygen was not found (it ships with OpenSSH and with Git for Windows).
errors.key_is_public: This is the public key (.pub): pick the private key file next to it.
errors.image_unreadable: Unreadable picture: choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG file.
errors.keyring_unavailable: System keyring unavailable (on Linux, a Secret Service is needed: GNOME Keyring, KWallet…).
errors.sign_failed: The commit could not be signed: check the profile signing key (and its passphrase).
errors.gpg_not_found: gpg was not found (it ships with Git for Windows, or with GnuPG / Gpg4win).
errors.no_profile: This repository has no active profile.
errors.remote_ref_not_found: This branch does not exist on this remote.
errors.remote_exists: A remote with this name already exists.
errors.token_invalid: Token rejected: it is wrong, expired or revoked.
errors.token_forbidden: Access denied with this token: missing scopes, missing SSO authorization or rate limit reached.
errors.token_missing: This account’s token is no longer in the system keychain: reconnect the account.
errors.provider_unreachable: Instance unreachable: check the address, the network connection and the server certificate.
errors.provider_not_found: This provider’s API does not answer at this address: check the instance address and the chosen provider.
errors.provider_unexpected: Unexpected answer: this address is not an instance of this provider.
errors.provider_error: The server answered with an error: try again later.
errors.clone_dest_exists: The destination folder already exists and is not empty.
errors.token_scope_missing: The token has no rights on keys (GitHub: admin:public_key, admin:ssh_signing_key, write:gpg_key; GitLab: api). Reconnect the account with a token that has them.
errors.key_in_use: This key is already registered, on this account or another one (GitHub accepts an SSH key on one account only).
errors.gpg_key_not_found: The profile’s GPG key was not found in the gpg keyring.
errors.public_key_missing: Public key not found: the key is protected and has no .pub file next to it.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.hint: A profile combines a Git identity (name, email) and the SSH key to use. GitGR applies the identity to every command in the repository and the key to its remotes, without touching your Git configuration.
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.identityHint: Applied by GitGR to every commit, without changing your global Git configuration.
profiles.sshNone: None: SSH uses its usual configuration (~/.ssh, agent).
profiles.generateLabel: Private key file (the public key goes next to it, as .pub)
profiles.generated: Key generated: {{path}}. Save the profile to use it.
profiles.keyEncrypted: Protected by a passphrase: save it so GitGR can use the key.
profiles.rulesHint: This profile is picked for a repository whose remote matches one of these rules — a host (github.com, *.example.com), optionally followed by an organization or group (github.com/my-org/*) — or that lives in one of these folders (~/work/*). A folder wins over a remote, then the most specific rule. In a repository with several remotes, a remote rule also picks the profile of each remote, hence its SSH key.
profiles.reposEmpty: No repositories yet: pick this profile from a repository (commit area or status bar).
profiles.deleteBody_zero: The SSH key is not deleted from disk.
profiles.deleteBody_one: The repository using it will fall back to the Git configuration. The SSH key is not deleted from disk.
profiles.deleteBody_other: The {{count}} repositories using it will fall back to the Git configuration. The SSH key is not deleted from disk.
profiles.discardBody: Changes to the “{{name}}” profile are not saved.
profiles.pillHint: Committing as {{name}} · {{email}} — click to change profile
profiles.pillNoneHint: No profile: the identity comes from the Git configuration — click to pick a profile
profiles.autoSelected: Profile “{{profile}}” picked for {{repo}} from its rules.
profiles.mismatchBody: The active profile “{{active}}” doesn’t match {{host}}, while “{{other}}” does.
profiles.imageHint: Shown instead of the initials (cropped to a square).
profiles.generateProtect: Protect the key with a passphrase (kept in the system keyring)
profiles.passphraseLabel: Passphrase (checked, then kept in the system keyring, never in GitGR’s files)
profiles.passphraseSaved: Passphrase saved in the system keyring.
profiles.signingHint_config: The Git configuration decides (commit.gpgsign, user.signingkey), as without a profile.
profiles.signingHint_off: Commits are never signed with this profile, even if the Git configuration asks for it.
profiles.signingHint_gpg: Every commit is signed with a GPG key. Its passphrase is asked by gpg (pinentry window), then kept by gpg-agent. Add the public key to your GitHub / GitLab account so commits show as “verified”.
profiles.signingHint_ssh: Every commit is signed with an SSH key (Git 2.34 or later). Its passphrase comes from the keyring, like the profile key. Add the public key as a “signing key” on GitHub / GitLab.
profiles.gpgAuto: Picked by gpg from the profile email
profiles.gpgNone: No secret GPG key found: create one (gpg --full-generate-key) or import it.
profiles.gpgEmailMismatch: No identity of this key uses {{email}}: GitHub / GitLab will show the signature as unverified.
profiles.sshSigningDefault: Empty: the profile SSH key is used.
profiles.sshSigningMissing: Pick a signing key, or an SSH key for the profile.
profiles.accountsHint: The account is used for the provider’s API (repositories, PRs / MRs). In a repository, each remote uses its profile’s account on its instance. The token is kept in the system keychain.
profiles.accountsNew: Save the profile first to connect an account to it.
profiles.accountDisconnectBody: The account {{login}} ({{instance}}) is removed from the profile “{{profile}}” and its token is forgotten if no other profile uses it. Nothing is revoked on {{provider}}.
profiles.accountDialogTitle: Connect an account to the profile “{{profile}}”
profiles.accountInstanceHint_github: Empty: github.com. For GitHub Enterprise, the address of the instance.
profiles.accountInstanceHint_gitlab: Empty: gitlab.com. For a self-hosted instance, its address.
profiles.accountInstanceInvalid: Invalid address: a host (gitlab.example.com) or an http(s) URL.
profiles.accountInsecure: Unencrypted connection (http): the token will travel in clear text over the network. Prefer https.
profiles.accountTokenHint_github: Classic token, scopes: repo, read:user, read:org, admin:public_key, admin:ssh_signing_key, write:gpg_key (pre-selected by the link).
profiles.accountTokenHint_gitlab: Scopes: api, read_user (pre-selected by the link).
profiles.keysUnsaved: Save the profile to check its new keys on the account.

branchColors.title: Colors by branch name
branchColors.help: A branch takes the color of the first rule matching its name (without the remote). “*” matches any characters.
